title: A long weekend at the Sydney Film Festival - 6 feature films, 6 reviews (including Kinds of Kindness and A24's A Different Man)

commenti.body:
This is a great write-up! Thanks for taking the time to make it. 


It is funny how tough it can be to express a bunch of very different "4/5" reactions. I think you did a good job clarifying how you felt about each film and why.

Thank you for this write up. I haven’t heard or seen any of these movies, but I now will look for them when they come to streaming.
